sloka: शतैः शत सहस्रैः च कोटिभिः च प्लवंगमाः ।अयुतैः च आवृता वीरा शंकुभिः च परंतप ॥४-३८-३०॥
transliteration: śataiḥ śata sahasraiḥ ca koṭibhiḥ ca plavaṁgamāḥ ।ayutaiḥ ca āvṛtā vīrā śaṁkubhiḥ ca paraṁtapa ॥4-38-30॥

translations.english: O scorcher of enemies the vanara troops in hundred thousand crores, ayutas, sanku, arbuda, hundreds of arbudas, madhyas, antyas, samudras and parardhas (100000000000000000), are expected. O king they are residents of Vindhya and Meru mountains, comparable to lord Indra in courage and appear like mountains Meru and Mandara.
translations.hindi: हुए : 7 शतैः शतसह रेव कोटिमिश्च छुवकुमाः । अयुतैश्वाद्ठता वीराः शङ्कभिश्च परन्तप
